summary: Great visual layout and typography hierarchy, but serious accessibility and contrast issues prevent this from being production-ready.

visualAccuracy.feedback: Card dimensions, padding, and font sizes closely match the reference spec with only minor 12% pixel drift on border-radius and button height.

accessibility.feedback: Failed WCAG AA contrast on the primary CTA. White text (#FFFFFF) on light blue (#93C5FD) gives only 2.1:1 contrast ratio, failing the minimum 4.5:1 requirement.
violationsSummary: Elements must have sufficient color contrast: CTA button text fails WCAG AA (ratio 2.1:1)

responsiveDesign.feedback: Card centers cleanly on both mobile and desktop viewports, though it lacks an explicit max-width clamp for smaller screens.

codeQuality.feedback: Clean CSS structure with sensible class names. Recommend switching from arbitrary pixel widths to relative units (rem/ch) and semantic `<article>` tags.

actionableFeedback.title: Fix Call-to-Action Color Contrast
actionableFeedback.detail: WCAG AA requires a 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text. Darken the button background to #2563EB or use darker text to ensure readability for visually impaired users.

actionableFeedback.title: Use Responsive Max-Width
actionableFeedback.detail: Hardcoding `width: 320px` can cause horizontal overflow on viewports below 320px. Use `width: 100%` paired with `max-width: 360px`.

actionableFeedback.title: Use Semantic HTML Tags
actionableFeedback.detail: Wrap the component in an `<article>` with an appropriate heading structure (`<h3>`) rather than a generic `<div>` to improve screen-reader document landmark navigation.
